record.name: Scientist
record.description: Scientists are masters of research and experimentation. They excel at conducting experiments, analyzing data, and making breakthrough discoveries that advance technology and understanding.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Genius inventors and researchers who drive technological advancements.

progression_tree.description: You have developed a comprehensive scientific theory that guides your research. You can use your proficiency bonus to analyze a single piece of evidence and gain insight into the workings of the universe.

effects.value: You can take a bonus action to analyze a piece of evidence, gaining insight into the workings of the universe.

progression_tree.description: You have created an experimental device that allows you to manipulate your environment in creative ways. You can use your proficiency bonus to activate the device and gain a benefit.

effects.value: Once per day, as a reaction, you can recharge one of your ability score actions.
